title: Lesson (post-incident learning)
description: Separates contributing factors (conditions that enabled the problem) from the root cause (why those conditions existed). A lesson needs a preventive control and a falsifiable verification; graded statuses need control_installed_at. 2.0 (ADR-0019): a lesson is identified by its `uid` (a UUIDv7 created with it) and names its `type`; the numbered `id` (and the LL-NEW placeholder a hook used to allocate) is gone, and the number it is shown with is computed from its place among its siblings (`order`, then creation). 2.1 (additive, ADR-0032): an optional `summary`, one reviewed line of at most 160 characters, the level 0 that context_for serves.

uid.description: A canonical UUIDv7: the record's identity, never changed.

order.description: Optional sort key among its siblings.

summary.description: Optional (ADR-0032): the record's level 0, one reviewed line of at most 160 characters; context_for serves it instead of the content. The pattern refuses control characters (C0, DEL, C1) and the common invisible format characters (soft hyphen, U+061C, U+180E, zero-width and direction marks U+200B-U+200F, line and paragraph separators and bidi embeddings U+2028-U+202E, U+2060-U+206F, the BOM, U+FFF9-U+FFFB); `(?!\n)` keeps a validator whose `$` matches before a final newline (Python's) from accepting one. `hnx registers summaries` and the record validation are authoritative: they refuse every character of the Unicode categories Cc, Cf, Zl, Zp and Cs and surrounding whitespace, and count a record without a summary as a warning.

symptom.description: What an observer sees; the lookup key.

root_cause.description: Why the contributing conditions existed. A person or a single command is not a root cause.

preventive_control.description: Must change what is possible or what is detectable.

verification.description: A falsifiable test of the control.
